_menu_doc: the order buildings appear in a worker's build menu (hotkeys are avoided where they clash with WASD panning and the debug keys)

archery_range.name: Archery Range
archery_range.desc: Trains your ranged soldiers: skirmishers, who hunt archers, and archers.

armoury.name: Armoury
armoury.desc: Where weapons and armour are improved: sharper points, better bows, tougher kit.
armoury.note: weapon and armour research (Sharp Sticks moved here, Dominic)

barracks.name: Barracks
barracks.desc: Trains your spearmen, the line that holds against riders and big beasts.
barracks.note: infantry (the spear line); the Archery Range and Stable train the rest

farm.name: Farm
farm.desc: A field of food that workers tend without walking far. When it's worked out it lies fallow; reseed it for wood.
farm.note: when built, its ground becomes crops (a rice paddy in water, for amphibians): one farm, one pool of food; worked out it lies fallow, and a worker can reseed it for wood

house.name: House
house.desc: Room for more of your people. Every unit needs space; without houses, training stops.

lumber_camp.name: Lumber Camp
lumber_camp.desc: A place to drop wood close to where it's cut. Woodcutting research is done here.

market.name: Market
market.desc: Buy and sell food, wood and stone for gold. Prices move with what everyone trades.
market.note: trade: buy/sell with gold, shared prices

mill.name: Mill
mill.desc: A place to drop food near bushes and farms. Foraging and farming research is done here.

mining_camp.name: Mining Camp
mining_camp.desc: A place to drop stone and gold close to the deposits. Mining research is done here.

stable.name: Stable
stable.desc: Trains your large unit: a rider, a giant or a heavy, whatever your race fields.
stable.note: the large unit (mounts, giants or heavies)

town_center.name: Town Center
town_center.desc: The heart of your town: trains workers, takes in every resource, and is where you age up. Lose it and you lose.

wall.name: Wall
wall.desc: A stone wall, one tile at a time: drag to lay a line. Stops anyone who can't fly.
wall.note: dragged in lines; flyers go over

watchtower.name: Watchtower
watchtower.desc: A lookout that shoots the nearest enemy in range and sees far into the fog.
watchtower.note: shoots the nearest enemy in range
